title: Spell it from the rack
scenario: Can the word be spelled from the tile rack, each tile used at most once?

intro.job: Can the word be spelled from the tile rack, each tile used at most once?

idea.rule: Being on the rack once isn't enough — each tile can only be spent once.
idea.detail: Think of the tile rack as a wallet of letters. Count how many of each letter it holds, then 'spend' one for every letter the word needs. If you try to spend a letter whose count is already 0, the word can't be spelled — even though that letter IS on the rack.

model_restatement: Check whether the rack has enough of every letter the word needs, counting repeats.

clarify.question: Can a tile be used twice?
clarify.answer: No — each tile can be used at most once.

clarify.question: What should I print?
clarify.answer: True if the word can be spelled, otherwise False.

clarify_fallback: Good question — assume the simple case.
blueprint: Word and tiles come as a pair. For each letter in the word, check it's on the rack; if one isn't, the word can't be spelled. Print the answer.

checkpoints.prompt: The word's second 'l' has just been checked — the loop moves on to 'o'. What is ok?
With the fix — after counting the whole rack (iteration 5), what is left?

why_line: 'l' in tiles only asks whether there's AN 'l' — it's True both times, so the second 'l' gets waved through even though the rack has just one.

explain.rule: 'in' checks the wallet has that coin — it doesn't take the coin out, so you can spend the same 'l' forever.
explain.bridge: So how could you keep track of how many of each letter are left to spend?

fix.rule: Count the rack's letters, then spend one per word letter — a count of 0 means you're out.

walk.gloss: ...and count each letter into the wallet.
For each word letter: none left? Then the word can't be spelled; otherwise spend one.

contrast.right_note: is there one left to spend?

alternatives.note: Spend by removing from a list — the same idea, slower on long racks.

hints: How many 'l's does the word need? How many does the rack have?
Count the rack's letters, then subtract one per word letter.

follow_up.prompt: New word: 'deed' from the tiles 'de' — can it be spelled?

checkpoint.prompt: With word 'deed' and tiles 'de', what gets printed?

follow_up.fix_hint: Nothing to change — the second 'd' finds the wallet empty.

one_liner: Being on the rack once isn't enough — each tile can only be spent once.
